player.seasonOutlook: One of four players in history with four 50-homer seasons, and one of three to hit 50-plus homers while winning the batting title (Jimmie Foxx, 1938; Mickey Mantle, 1956), Judge is baseball's preeminent all-around hitter. He has claimed three of the past four AL MVP awards, covering a span during which he hit .311 with an average of 53 home runs, 116 RBI, 118 runs scored and 114 walks per year. Now 33, Judge has also sufficiently answered the injury question that plagued him earlier in his career, as he has appeared in at least 152 games in three of the past four years, while batting .305/.473/.634 with 16 homers across his final 49 regular-season contests following a 10-day IL stint for an elbow issue in July/August. He's an exemplary choice to begin your draft in any fantasy format.
